highlights: The AI landscape is seeing a surge in highly capable agentic models, particularly in coding and complex decision-making, coupled with advanced benchmarks for real-world performance evaluation.

Significant progress in model efficiency and accessibility is evident, with new open-weight models and practical tools designed for faster inference and deployment on resource-constrained environments.

Key platform providers like Google and Perplexity are enhancing developer capabilities through robust APIs, multi-model orchestration, and strategic enterprise integrations, streamlining AI development workflows.

agents.title: Google DeepMind Releases Gemini 4 Neon: 1M Context, #1 on AA Coding Agent Index
agents.summary: Google has launched Gemini 4 Neon, a 1M-context model priced competitively, which has achieved the #1 ranking on the AA Coding Agent Index, offering superior performance for complex code generation and problem-solving.

agents.title: RadixArk Ships DaisyRose-27B, a 27B Agentic Coding Model Trained With Reinforcement Learning Only
agents.summary: RadixArk unveiled DaisyRose-27B, an Apache 2.0 agentic coding model trained purely with reinforcement learning, significantly boosting Terminal Bench 4.1 pass@1 to 12.0 and capable of running on a single GPU.

agents.title: SID AI Releases SID-2 Agentic Search Model With 0.720 NDCG Swarm Mode
agents.summary: SID AI introduced SID-2, an agentic search model trained with reinforcement learning, achieving 0.720 NDCG in a 12-agent Swarm Mode, surpassing GPT-6 Astra on SID’s benchmark for advanced search capabilities.

models.title: NVIDIA AI Releases Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, a Continuous Diffusion Language Model with 14 checkpoints at 3B/8B
models.summary: NVIDIA has released Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, offering 14 open 3B and 8B continuous diffusion language model checkpoints that denoise text in a 16-D embedding space, enabling up to 4.20x faster decoding than autoregressive methods.

models.title: New LoRA Adapter Lifts Qwen3.8 Coding Success From 39% to 65%
models.summary: Hugging Face released Qwen3.8-27B-pi-adapted, an Apache-2.0 LoRA adapter trained with reinforcement learning, which significantly boosts coding success rates on SWE-bench Pro and Terminal-Bench for the pi coding agent.

models.title: Welcome Inkling 2 Mini, Cutting-edge Performance for your Local Setup
models.summary: Hugging Face announced Inkling 2 Mini, a new model designed to deliver cutting-edge performance for local AI setups, enabling developers to run advanced models efficiently on their own hardware.

tools.title: Perplexity Launches Orchestrator API for Failover and Model Routing
tools.summary: Perplexity introduced its Orchestrator API, providing a single endpoint for accessing models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, and open-weight options, featuring same-model provider failover, unified billing, and intelligent request routing.

tools.title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
tools.summary: Google has launched Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API, now in preview, allowing developers to give their AI agents access to hundreds of tools more efficiently while consuming fewer tokens.

tools.title: Introducing harness adapters: adapt your favorite model to your harness to improve performance and cost
tools.summary: Hugging Face released harness adapters, enabling developers to fine-tune and optimize their preferred models for specific harnesses, significantly improving performance and reducing operational costs.

companies.title: Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare.
companies.summary: Google Cloud has launched Gemini for healthcare, aiming to unify clinical data and automate workflows, thereby reducing administrative burnout and enhancing efficiency in the medical sector.

companies.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
companies.summary: OpenAI detailed its layered approach to combatting adversarial distillation, combining model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against unauthorized capability extraction from its AI models.

companies.title: Hugging Face and OpenRouter join forces to make open-weight models easy to run
companies.summary: Hugging Face and OpenRouter have partnered to simplify the deployment and running of open-weight AI models, increasing accessibility for developers and researchers leveraging community models.

learning.title: Not If, But How: Responding to Security Incidents in the Age of AI Attackers
learning.summary: This guide provides a 4-pillar incident response playbook for AI infrastructure, reviewing recent incidents and demonstrating practical application through case studies from Fireworks AI and Klue, crucial for securing AI systems.

learning.title: The Definitive Fine-Tuning Guide for 3D Generation Models
learning.summary: Hugging Face released a comprehensive guide for fine-tuning 3D generation models, offering detailed instructions and best practices for developers working with advanced 3D content creation.

learning.title: Research acceleration: The jagged frontier
learning.summary: OpenAI explores how coding agents are accelerating AI research, analyzing their performance across various tasks, identifying areas of unevenness, and discussing the implications for recursive self-improvement in AI development.
